items.headline: NFL Week 3 uniforms: Colts to wear 'Anvil Strike,' Bills debut 'Nickel City'
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 3, led by the new NFL Rivalries look from the Indianapolis Colts.

items.headline: Denver Broncos to face another MVP QB in Matthew Stafford
items.description: Sunday marks the 10th time the Broncos have faced an MVP quarterback since Vance Joseph became defensive coordinator in 2023. Can Denver get the best of Stafford?

items.headline: Bo Nix gets more freedom at the line
items.description: Jeff Legwold explains how Davis Webb is giving Bo Nix more freedom to change plays at the line of scrimmage.

items.headline: Broncos RB Coleman doesn't practice; Dobbins, Harvey limited
items.description: Broncos running backs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey were limited in practice Wednesday, and Jonah Coleman did not practice. Nevertheless, coach Sean Payton said he thinks "we're going to be all right" at the position Sunday against the Rams.

items.headline: Seahawks' Macdonald apologizes to Broncos' Payton for comments
items.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.

items.headline: Evaluating surprise early-season trends for 32 NFL teams
items.description: T.J. Watt is dominant again? The Packers can't run the ball? Drew Lock is fourth in QBR? Let's figure out which early stats and trends have staying power and which are a mirage.
